# Data Source: tfe_projects

Gets information on all projects in an organization.

## Example Usage

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        new DataTfeProjects.DataTfeProjects(this, "all", new DataTfeProjectsConfig {
            Organization = "my-org-name"
        });
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `Organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.

### Read-Only

- `Id` (String) Name of the organization for use as an ID.
- `Projects` (Attributes List) List of projects in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `Projects`

Read-Only:

- `Description` (String) Description of the project.
- `Id` (String) ID of the project.
- `Name` (String) Name of the project.
- `Organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.
